Name: Cross-AZ Data Transfer
Cost Driver: Data transferred between AZs within a region
Mitigation: $0.01/GB seems small but adds up at TB scale; use AZ-affinity placement groups
Gotcha: Replicated databases double or triple this cost silently

Name: Internet Egress
Cost Driver: Data leaving the cloud to the internet
Mitigation: Use CDN (CloudFront/Cloudflare) to cache at edge; compress payloads
Gotcha: First 100GB/month free on AWS; GCP charges $0.12/GB for premium tier

Name: NAT Gateway Processing
Cost Driver: Per-GB charge for all traffic through NAT gateway
Mitigation: Use VPC endpoints for S3/DynamoDB; use Gateway LB endpoints
Gotcha: Often forgotten — even internal traffic to S3 through NAT is charged

Name: DynamoDB On-Demand Pricing
Cost Driver: Read/write request units on-demand mode
Mitigation: Use provisioned capacity with auto-scaling for predictable workloads
Gotcha: Hot partition keys cause throttling even with capacity available

Name: DynamoDB Provisioned vs On-Demand
Cost Driver: Choosing wrong capacity mode for workload pattern
Mitigation: Profile traffic patterns; use provisioned + auto-scaling for steady-state workloads
Order of Magnitude: Provisioned can be 5-7x cheaper than on-demand for steady traffic
Gotcha: Switching modes has a 24h cooldown period

Name: S3 Request Pricing
Cost Driver: PUT/GET/LIST request charges accumulate at high volumes
Mitigation: Batch operations; use S3 Inventory instead of LIST; choose storage class wisely
Gotcha: Small files amplify request costs — 1M small files costs more than 1 large file

Name: S3 Storage Classes
Cost Driver: Choosing wrong storage class for access pattern
Mitigation: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering for unpredictable access; lifecycle rules for known patterns
Gotcha: Minimum storage duration charges — 30d for IA; 90d for Glacier IR; 180d for Glacier

Name: GPU Instance Costs
Cost Driver: ML training and inference GPU costs
Mitigation: Use spot/preemptible instances; right-size GPU type; use inference-specific chips
Gotcha: Reserved instances save 40-60% but require 1-3 year commitment

Name: CloudWatch Logs Ingestion
Cost Driver: Log ingestion and storage charges
Mitigation: Sample verbose logs; use log levels; send to S3 for long-term storage
Gotcha: Custom metrics at $0.30/metric/month — 1000 custom metrics = $300/month

Name: Load Balancer Idle Costs
Cost Driver: Minimum hourly charge even with zero traffic
Mitigation: Delete unused LBs; consolidate with shared ALB + path-based routing
Order of Magnitude: ALB ~$16/month base + LCU; NLB ~$16/month base + NLCU
Gotcha: Each ALB rule adds cost; use fewer rules with regex patterns

Name: RDS Multi-AZ Costs
Cost Driver: Multi-AZ doubles instance cost for HA
Mitigation: Use Multi-AZ only for production; read replicas for read scaling are cheaper
Gotcha: Aurora Multi-AZ is included in the base price (different model from RDS)

Name: Kubernetes Cluster Overhead
Cost Driver: Control plane + node overhead costs
Mitigation: Use Fargate/Autopilot for small clusters; right-size node pools
Order of Magnitude: EKS $0.10/hr control plane; GKE Autopilot charges per-pod
Gotcha: System pods (kube-system) consume 10-20% of small clusters

Name: GCP BigQuery Pricing
Cost Driver: On-demand query pricing per TB scanned
Mitigation: Use partitioned/clustered tables; LIMIT doesn't reduce scan cost
Gotcha: SELECT * on a 10TB table = $62.50 per query; column pruning is critical

Name: VPC Endpoint Costs
Cost Driver: Interface endpoints charge per hour + per GB
Mitigation: Use Gateway endpoints (free) for S3/DynamoDB; Interface endpoints for other services
Gotcha: Gateway endpoints for S3/DynamoDB are free — use them instead of NAT

Name: Container Registry Storage
Cost Driver: Image storage and transfer costs grow with CI/CD frequency
Mitigation: Implement image lifecycle policies; use multi-stage builds for smaller images
Gotcha: Untagged images accumulate silently; lifecycle policies are essential

Name: Secrets Manager Costs
Cost Driver: Per-secret per-month charge + API call charges
Mitigation: Use SSM Parameter Store (free tier) for non-rotating secrets
Gotcha: 1000 secrets = $400/month; consider HashiCorp Vault for large scale

Name: Data Transfer Between Regions
Cost Driver: Cross-region replication and sync costs
Mitigation: Minimize cross-region traffic; use regional deployments where possible
Gotcha: Multi-region architectures multiply all data transfer costs

Name: Lambda Invocation Costs
Cost Driver: Per-request + duration charges at scale
Mitigation: Right-size memory allocation (affects CPU); use provisioned concurrency for consistent loads
Gotcha: Cold starts on provisioned concurrency still bill; 1B invocations/month = $200 base

Name: ElastiCache Node Costs
Cost Driver: Instance costs for in-memory caching
Mitigation: Right-size node type; use reserved nodes for steady-state; consider Serverless option
Gotcha: Cluster mode disabled limits to single shard — can't scale writes horizontally

Name: FinOps Tagging Strategy
Cost Driver: Lack of cost attribution makes optimization impossible
Mitigation: Enforce mandatory tags (team/env/service) via SCP/org policies; use cost allocation tags
Order of Magnitude: Untagged resources often represent 30-50% of cloud spend
Gotcha: Tags must be activated in billing console separately from resource tags

Name: Managed Kafka (MSK) Costs
Cost Driver: Broker instance + storage + data transfer costs
Mitigation: Right-size broker count; use tiered storage; consider MSK Serverless for variable loads
Gotcha: Storage charges $0.10/GB/month; 1TB retention = $100/month additional

Name: CloudFront Costs
Cost Driver: Request pricing varies by region + data transfer
Mitigation: Use Origin Shield to reduce origin fetches; compress assets; set appropriate TTLs
Gotcha: Regional pricing varies 2x; invalidation requests cost $0.005 each after first 1000
